entities.summary: Anna Ivanovna Kuzmina was a Yakut Russian actress and author of the Soviet era and after. She was born in Khangalassky District, Russia. For her work she was named an Honored Artist of the RSFSR (1982) and People's Artist of the Republic of Sakha (2003).
